# sofascore_scraper.store.StreamLog
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/streams.py
class StreamLog:
    def __init__(self, store: 'Store') -> None
    def append(self, stream: str, events: Sequence[StreamEvent]) -> List[Optional[int]]
    def read(self, *, after: int = 0, limit: int = DEFAULT_READ_LIMIT, streams: Sequence[str] = (), types: Sequence[str] = (), event_ids: Sequence[int] = (), sport: Optional[str] = None, tournament_ids: Sequence[int] = ()) -> StreamBatch
    def head(self) -> StreamHead
    def wait(self, *, after: int, timeout: float) -> bool
    def prune(self, *, max_age_s: Optional[float] = DEFAULT_PRUNE_MAX_AGE_SECONDS, max_rows: Optional[int] = DEFAULT_PRUNE_MAX_ROWS) -> int
    def cursor(self, sink: str) -> int
    def cursors(self) -> List[SinkCursor]
    def set_cursor(self, sink: str, seq: int, *, error: Optional[str] = None) -> None
